title: Operational language and replay contract
summary: The dev8 line describes operational state using stable semantic references, dimensional metric samples, freshness, complete relationship scopes, replay-safe events and producer-declared correlation/causation.

contract.identity: instrumentation:// stable semantic reference derived from estate/service/instance/node identity; optional MI and deployment attributes do not replace identity
contract.metrics: COUNTER, GAUGE, RATE, STATE, PROGRESS and DISTRIBUTION; repeated series are separated by canonical dimensions
contract.freshness: FRESH/LATE/STALE/UNKNOWN is observer evidence and remains separate from source health
contract.relationships: complete authority+scope relationship sets; disappearance means no longer visible in newer evidence, not an inferred delete/failover
contract.events: replay-safe bounded operational events, with source events distinguished from observer-derived changes
contract.correlation: only explicit producer correlation_id/context_refs/causation_id grouping; time or topology proximity never proves correlation or causation
contract.publication: atomic publisher batches fenced by monotonic sequence and publication identity

privacy: Do not publish message bodies, credentials, mailbox names, LDAP DNs or arbitrary customer identifiers by default.
Do not expose raw private RPC correlation ids by default; map to an explicit opaque observability token when required.
Do not turn Alchemy Log forensic/audit evidence into bounded Instrumentation samples.
